intro: Senegal's economy is based on fishing, farming, phosphates, services and now oil and gas.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Fish, peanuts, phosphates and gold are big exports. Offshore oil began flowing in 2024, and gas soon after.
Overfishing by foreign fleets has hit local fishers, and many young people have tried to reach Europe by boat.

chapters.title: Dakar
text: Dakar is a hub for business, with a new city at Diamniadio.

keyTerms.meaning: Catching fish faster than they can breed.
